library: pg narrow SQL ports; no external queue or Redis
clock: DB clock_timestamp after locks; monotonic elapsed supervisor timers

dispatch.ordering: available capability slots, rotating workspace lanes; due/created/id inside lane

retry.retryAfter: MAX_BACKOFF_AND_SERVER_FLOOR; never cap a provider floor downward
retry.quota: Reserve before each provider call; unknown outcome consumes quota; no auto paid fallback

schedule.catchUp: latest due occurrence only; historical quote backfill separate rights-gated task
schedule.coalesce: exact compatible entitlement/profile/instrument set and unfinished outcome
schedule.advanceWatermark: atomic domain+enqueue or explicit missed/disabled disposition; never from last_success

sync.ordering: session/workspace generation + recovery epoch before financial/object versions
sync.offline: native capture allowed under live local consent; owner financial writes need online preview/commit

recovery: ARCH07 locked restore/witness first; old jobs/tokens fenced; no automatic financial replay
